create_roberta_model: create a RobertaModel instance with RobertaConfig for encoder or decoder mode
build_roberta_embeddings: build RobertaEmbeddings with word, position, and token_type embeddings for input tokenization
test_roberta_attention: test RobertaSelfAttention and RobertaCrossAttention with query, key, value projections and causal masking
refactor_roberta_encoder: refactor RobertaEncoder to stack RobertaLayer modules with self-attention and optional cross-attention
run_roberta_forward: run RobertaModel forward pass with input_ids, attention_mask, and optional past_key_values for inference
